opennyai_summary.facts:
By this application, the applicant is seeking the relief of pre- arrest bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short "Cr.P.C."), as he apprehends arrest in connection with Crime Register No.129 of 2022 registered with Alibaug Police Station, Raigad.
The offences alleged against him are punishable under Sections 328, 272, 273, 188 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short "IPC"), and also under Sections 26(1), 26(2)(ii), 26(2)(iv), 26(3),
30(2)(a), and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
As per the prosecution, the informant, one Vishwajit Vithhal Shinde, who is a Food Inspector,
conducted a series of raids on 31 May 2022 along with his team and a panch witness.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The record shows that the applicant has co-operated with the investigation.
The prosecution has now filed the charge- sheet, which means custodial interrogation of the applicant is no longer necessary.
The interim order has remained in operation for more than two years, and during this period, no breach of conditions by the applicant has been reported.
In such circumstances, there is no justification to recall the protection which has already been enjoyed without any misuse.
6. Therefore, considering the settled principles that anticipatory bail can be confirmed if the applicant has cooperated with the investigation, charge-sheet is filed, and interim protection has been in force without misuse, I am of the view that the applicant has made out a case for confirmation of interim relief.

7. Accordingly, the interim protection granted to the applicant vide order dated 13 July 2022 stands confirmed.
